gauntlet: question
The repaired criterion in acme/widgets#77 now requires the shared settings resolver, so the design will use that existing path. What should the new setting’s default behavior be when switching workspaces?
A) Reset report filters by default, with a setting to preserve them instead.
B) Preserve report filters by default, with a setting to enable resetting.
C) other - name it.
Recommendation: A - it prevents filters from silently hiding rows in the new workspace while allowing users to retain the current behavior.
